name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Wok-fried rice with chicken, egg, peas and carrots
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and spread on a plate to steam dry
Cut the chicken into small pieces, dice the onion and carrots, and fry them in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until the chicken is cooked through
Add the peas and ginger, then push everything aside, crack in the egg and scramble it in the empty half of the pan
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes until everything is hot and coated

name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
description: Glazed salmon over rice with broccoli and carrot
seasonings: sesame seeds if you have them
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes; add the broccoli florets to the pot for the last 3 minutes, then drain
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the salmon for 3 minutes per side
Pour the teriyaki over the salmon and let it bubble for 1 minute, spooning the glaze over the fish
Serve the salmon on the rice with the broccoli and the carrots, coarsely grated, and pour over any glaze left in the pan

name: Tofu and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Crispy tofu with broccoli and peppers in a garlic soy sauce, on rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Pat the tofu dry, cut it into cubes and fry it in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides
Add the broccoli in small florets, the sliced peppers and a splash of water and stir-fry for 4 minutes
Stir in the chopped garlic, ginger, pepper and soy sauce, cook 1 more minute and serve over the rice

name: Shrimp Noodle Stir-Fry
description: Quick stir-fried noodles with shrimp, peppers and carrot
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water according to the packet, usually 4 minutes, then drain and rinse briefly
Slice the peppers and onion and cut the carrots into thin strips, then stir-fry them in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes
Add the shrimp and ginger and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the shrimp are pink
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce, heat through for 1 minute and finish with lime juice

name: Peanut Chicken Noodle Salad
description: Cold noodles with chicken, cucumber and a peanut dressing
instructions: Simmer the chicken in lightly salted water for 12 minutes until cooked through, then shred it with two forks
Cook the noodles according to the packet, drain and rinse under cold water until cool
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime juice and warm water into a pourable dressing
Cut the cucumber and carrots into thin strips and toss everything together with the dressing

name: Egg Fried Rice with Peas
description: Simple fried rice with scrambled egg, peas and carrot
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it steam dry for a few minutes
Finely dice the onion and carrots and fry them in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes, then add the peas
Push the vegetables aside, crack in the eggs and scramble them until just set
Add the rice and soy sauce, stir-fry for 2 minutes and season with pepper

name: Spicy Beef Lettuce Cups
description: Chili-garlic beef mince with rice, served in crisp lettuce leaves
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Brown the beef mince in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes, breaking it up
Add the chopped garlic, ginger, chili flakes and soy sauce and cook for 2 minutes
Separate the lettuce into cups, fill them with rice, beef and the grated carrots and finish with lime juice

name: Spicy Coconut Chickpea Curry
description: Chickpeas and spinach simmered in a spiced coconut tomato sauce
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then add the chopped garlic, curry powder and chili flakes for 1 minute
Add the chopped tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and season with salt

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
description: Sticky teriyaki chicken with rice, broccoli and carrot
seasonings: sesame seeds if you have them
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, adding the broccoli florets and sliced carrots for the last 3 minutes, then drain
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden and cooked through
Add the teriyaki and let it bubble for 1 minute until sticky
Serve the chicken and its sauce over the rice and vegetables

name: Ginger Turkey Noodle Soup
description: Light broth with turkey, noodles, mushrooms and spinach
instructions: Slice the turkey thinly and brown it in the oil in a pot for 3 minutes with the chopped garlic and ginger
Add the water, stock cube, sliced carrots and mushrooms and simmer for 6 minutes
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes until soft
Stir in the spinach and soy sauce and serve as soon as the spinach wilts

name: Spicy Tofu Fried Rice
description: Fried rice with golden tofu, peas, peppers and chili
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it steam dry
Cut the tofu into small cubes and fry in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until golden
Add the diced carrots and peppers, the peas, ginger and chili flakes and stir-fry for 3 minutes
Add the rice and soy sauce and fry for 2 more minutes

name: Spicy Tuna Rice Bowl
description: Rice bowl with tuna, avocado, cucumber and a spicy soy dressing
seasonings: 1 tsp sriracha or other chili sauce
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it cool slightly
Mix the drained tuna with the soy sauce, chili sauce and lime juice
Dice the avocado and cucumber and grate the carrots
Fill a bowl with the rice and arrange the tuna, avocado, cucumber and carrots on top

name: Chicken Fajita Wraps
description: Spiced chicken, peppers and onion in warm tortillas
instructions: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips and toss the chicken with the cumin, paprika and salt
Fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through
Add the peppers and onion and cook for 4 minutes until soft with charred edges
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, fill them and finish with lime juice

name: Bean and Cheese Quesadilla
description: Crisp tortilla filled with kidney beans, corn and melted cheese
instructions: Roughly mash the drained kidney beans with the cumin and salt, then stir in the corn
Spread the beans over one tortilla, scatter over the grated cheese and top with the second tortilla
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese has melted
Cut into wedges and serve with the diced tomato

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
description: Rice bowl with spiced chicken, beans, corn, tomato and lettuce
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Cut the chicken into small pieces, coat with the cumin, paprika and salt and fry in the oil for 6 minutes until cooked through
Warm the drained kidney beans and corn in the same pan for 1 minute
Fill a bowl with the rice, chicken, beans and corn, top with diced tomato and shredded lettuce and squeeze over lime juice

name: Beef Tacos
description: Spiced beef mince in soft tortillas with lettuce, tomato and cheese
instructions: Brown the beef mince with the diced onion in a dry pan over high heat for 6 minutes
Stir in the cumin, paprika, chili flakes, salt and a splash of water and cook for 2 more minutes
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Fill them with the beef, shredded lettuce, diced tomato and grated cheese

name: Sweet Potato and Bean Burrito
description: Burrito filled with spiced sweet potato, kidney beans and corn
instructions: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 1 cm cubes
Fry it in the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning now and then, until tender and browned
Add the drained kidney beans, corn, cumin, paprika and salt and cook for 2 minutes, lightly crushing some of the beans
Warm the tortilla, pile the filling down the middle, add lime juice, fold in the sides and roll up

name: Shrimp and Avocado Tacos
description: Chili-lime shrimp in tortillas with avocado, tomato and lettuce
instructions: Toss the shrimp with the chili flakes, cumin and salt and fry in the oil over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until pink
Mash the avocado with lime juice and a pinch of salt
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and spread them with the avocado
Top with the shrimp, diced tomato and shredded lettuce

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: Tomato broth with chicken, beans and corn, topped with crisp tortilla strips
instructions: Cut the tortilla into thin strips and toast them in a dry pot over medium heat for 3 minutes until crisp, then set aside
Soften the diced onion in the oil for 3 minutes, then add the cumin and chili flakes
Add the chopped tomatoes, water, stock cube and the chicken in small pieces and simmer for 12 minutes
Stir in the drained kidney beans and corn, heat for 2 minutes, add lime juice and serve topped with the tortilla strips

name: Smoky Bean Chili
description: Kidney bean and vegetable chili with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Dice the onion and peppers and soften them in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the paprika, cumin and chili flakes
Add the chopped tomatoes and drained kidney beans and simmer for 12 minutes until thick
Stir in the corn, season with salt and serve over the rice

name: Huevos Rancheros
description: Fried eggs on tortillas with beans and a spicy tomato sauce
instructions: Soften the diced onion in half the oil for 3 minutes, add the chili flakes and cumin, then the chopped tomatoes, and simmer for 6 minutes
Stir in the drained kidney beans and warm through
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, spoon over the beans and sauce and top each with an egg

name: Turkey Taco Salad
description: Spiced turkey mince over lettuce with tomato, corn, beans and avocado
instructions: Brown the turkey mince in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes with the cumin, paprika and salt
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato and avocado
Arrange the lettuce in a bowl and top with the turkey, tomato, corn, drained kidney beans and avocado
Squeeze over lime juice

name: Tofu Fajita Bowl
description: Spiced tofu with peppers, onion and corn over rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Cut the tofu into strips, coat with the cumin, paprika and salt and fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes
Add the sliced peppers and onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and lightly charred
Stir in the corn and serve over the rice with lime juice

name: Bean, Corn and Avocado Salad
description: No-cook salad of kidney beans, corn, peppers, tomato and avocado
instructions: Drain and rinse the kidney beans and corn
Dice the peppers, tomato and avocado
Toss everything with the olive oil, cumin, lime juice, salt and coriander

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
description: Cold pasta with mozzarella, tomato, spinach and pesto
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet, drain and rinse under cold water
Dice the tomato and tear the mozzarella into pieces
Toss the pasta with the pesto, tomato, mozzarella and spinach and season with pepper

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
description: Pasta salad with tuna, corn, tomato and cucumber in a lemon olive oil dressing
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet, drain and rinse under cold water
Dice the tomato and cucumber
Toss the pasta with the drained tuna, corn, tomato, cucumber, olive oil, lemon juice and oregano and season

name: Minestrone
description: Chunky vegetable and bean soup with pasta and parmesan
instructions: Dice the onion, carrots and zucchini and soften them in the olive oil in a pot for 5 minutes
Add the chopped tomatoes, water, stock cube and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes
Add the pasta and drained kidney beans and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until the pasta is tender
Serve topped with the grated parmesan and black pepper

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta
description: Pasta with pan-fried chicken, pesto, spinach and tomato
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain, keeping a little of the water
Cut the chicken into strips, season and fry in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden
Add the diced tomato and spinach and cook for 1 minute until the spinach wilts
Toss in the pasta, pesto and a splash of the pasta water

name: Spinach and Mushroom Frittata
description: Thick Italian omelette with mushrooms, spinach and parmesan, with bread
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and onion and fry them in the olive oil in a small non-stick pan for 5 minutes
Add the spinach and let it wilt
Beat the eggs with the grated parmesan, salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and cook over low heat, covered, for 6 to 8 minutes until set
Slide onto a plate and serve with the bread

name: Pasta e Ceci
description: Thick Italian chickpea and pasta soup with tomato and garlic
instructions: Finely dice the onion and carrots and soften them in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the chopped garlic and rosemary
Add the chopped tomatoes, water, stock cube and drained chickpeas and simmer for 8 minutes
Crush some of the chickpeas against the side of the pot to thicken the soup
Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until tender, then season with pepper

name: Quick Turkey Bolognese
description: Lean turkey mince in a tomato sauce with pasta
instructions: Finely dice the onion and carrots and soften them in the olive oil for 4 minutes
Add the turkey mince and brown it for 5 minutes, then stir in the chopped garlic and oregano
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes
Meanwhile cook the pasta in salted boiling water, drain and toss with the sauce

name: Garlic Chili Shrimp Spaghetti
description: Spaghetti with shrimp, garlic, chili, tomato and spinach
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain, keeping a little of the water
Warm the olive oil in a pan and gently fry the sliced garlic and chili flakes for 1 minute
Add the shrimp and diced tomato and cook for 3 minutes until the shrimp are pink
Toss in the pasta, spinach and a splash of pasta water and finish with lemon juice

name: Salmon and Pea Pesto Pasta
description: Pasta with flaked salmon, peas and pesto
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain
Fry the salmon in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, then break it into flakes
Toss the pasta and peas with the pesto and fold in the salmon
Season with pepper and lemon juice

name: Vegetable and Chickpea Pasta
description: Pasta with zucchini, peppers and chickpeas in tomato sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain
Dice the zucchini and peppers and fry them in the olive oil over medium-high heat for 7 minutes until soft and browned
Add the drained chickpeas, tomato sauce and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes
Toss with the pasta and season

name: Chicken Caprese Salad
description: Sliced chicken with mozzarella, tomato, lettuce and pesto
instructions: Season the chicken and fry it in the olive oil over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice
Slice the tomato and mozzarella and arrange them over the lettuce
Top with the chicken and spoon over the pesto

name: Greek Chicken Salad
description: Grilled chicken over cucumber, tomato and lettuce with feta
instructions: Season the chicken with the oregano, salt and pepper and fry in half the olive oil over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice
Chop the cucumber, tomato and lettuce and put them in a bowl
Top with the chicken and crumbled feta and dress with the remaining olive oil and lemon juice

name: Chickpea Couscous Salad
description: Lemony couscous with chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and peppers
instructions: Put the couscous in a bowl with a pinch of salt, pour over the boiling water, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork
Dice the cucumber, tomato and peppers
Mix everything with the drained chickpeas, olive oil, the juice of the lemon, cumin and chopped parsley

name: Chickpea and Feta Wrap
description: Tortilla with crushed chickpeas, feta, cucumber, tomato and yogurt
instructions: Roughly crush the drained chickpeas with a fork and mix them with the yogurt, cumin, lemon juice and pepper
Dice the cucumber and tomato and crumble the feta
Spread the chickpeas over the tortilla, top with the vegetables and feta and roll up tightly

name: Turkish Eggs with Garlic Yogurt
description: Poached eggs on garlic yogurt with chili butter and bread
instructions: Stir the finely grated garlic and a pinch of salt into the yogurt and spread it in a shallow bowl
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3 minutes and lift them onto the yogurt
Melt the butter with the chili flakes and paprika until it foams and pour it over the eggs
Serve with the toasted bread

name: Tuna and Chickpea Salad
description: No-cook salad of tuna, chickpeas, tomato and cucumber with lemon
instructions: Drain the tuna and chickpeas
Dice the tomato and cucumber and slice the onion very thinly
Toss everything with the olive oil, the juice of the lemon, salt, pepper and chopped parsley

name: Lemony Lentil Soup
description: Smooth-ish lentil and carrot soup with spinach and lemon
instructions: Dice the onion and carrots and soften them in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the chopped garlic and cumin
Add the rinsed lentils, chopped tomatoes, water and stock cube and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft
Stir in the spinach until wilted
Add the juice of the lemon and black pepper

name: Chicken Gyros Wrap
description: Oregano chicken in a tortilla with yogurt, cucumber, tomato and onion
instructions: Cut the chicken into thin strips, toss with the oregano, paprika and salt and fry in the olive oil over high heat for 5 to 6 minutes
Slice the cucumber, tomato and onion
Warm the tortilla, spread it with the yogurt and fill with the chicken and vegetables
Squeeze over lemon juice and roll up

name: Salmon Couscous Bowl
description: Flaked salmon over lemon couscous with cucumber, tomato and spinach
instructions: Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork
Fry the salmon in the olive oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side and break into flakes
Dice the cucumber and tomato
Serve the couscous on the spinach with the vegetables and salmon, with the juice of the lemon squeezed over

name: Quinoa Greek Salad
description: Quinoa with chickpeas, feta, cucumber, tomato and peppers
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in salted water for 12 to 15 minutes, then drain and let it cool a little
Dice the cucumber, tomato and peppers
Toss the quinoa with the vegetables, drained chickpeas, olive oil, oregano and lemon juice
Crumble the feta over the top

name: Spanish Potato Omelette
description: Thick omelette of potato and onion cooked in olive oil
instructions: Cut the potatoes into thin slices and slice the onion
Cook them gently in the olive oil in a small non-stick pan, covered, for 12 to 15 minutes until soft but not browned
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper, stir in the potatoes and onion, and pour everything back into the pan
Cook over low heat for 5 minutes, flip using a plate and cook 3 more minutes until set

name: Garlic Shrimp with Zucchini Couscous
description: Chili-garlic shrimp over couscous with zucchini and lemon
instructions: Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork
Dice the zucchini and fry it in the olive oil over high heat for 4 minutes
Add the shrimp, sliced garlic and chili flakes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the shrimp are pink
Serve over the couscous with the juice of the lemon

name: Beef Kofta Wrap
description: Spiced beef kofta in a tortilla with yogurt, cucumber, tomato and lettuce
instructions: Mix the beef mince with the cumin, paprika, chili flakes and salt and shape it into {3} short sausages
Fry them in a dry non-stick pan over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through
Slice the cucumber and tomato and shred the lettuce
Warm the tortilla, spread with the yogurt, add the kofta and vegetables and roll up

name: Mediterranean Tofu Couscous Bowl
description: Oregano tofu with zucchini, peppers and tomato over couscous
instructions: Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork
Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in the olive oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden
Add the diced zucchini and peppers with the oregano and cook for 5 minutes
Serve over the couscous with the diced tomato and a squeeze of lemon

name: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowl
description: Spiced chicken over rice with garlic yogurt, cucumber and tomato
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Slice the chicken thinly and coat it with the cumin, paprika, chili flakes, coriander and salt
Fry in the olive oil over high heat for 6 minutes until browned at the edges
Serve over the rice with the diced cucumber and tomato and a spoon of yogurt

name: Lentil and Feta Salad
description: Warm lentils with feta, tomato, cucumber and spinach
instructions: Simmer the rinsed lentils in unsalted water for 20 to 25 minutes until tender but still holding their shape, then drain
Dice the tomato and cucumber
Toss the warm lentils with the olive oil, vinegar, salt and pepper, then fold in the spinach, tomato and cucumber
Crumble the feta over the top

name: Chicken Salad Wrap
description: Tortilla with chicken, lettuce, tomato, cucumber and a yogurt dressing
instructions: Season the chicken and fry it in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice
Stir the mustard and a pinch of salt into the yogurt
Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato and cucumber
Spread the yogurt over the tortilla, add the chicken and vegetables and roll up

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
description: Chopped egg in a mustard yogurt dressing with lettuce and cucumber
instructions: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool them under cold water and peel
Chop the eggs and mix with the yogurt, mustard, salt and pepper
Pile onto one slice of bread with the lettuce and sliced cucumber and top with the second slice

name: Tuna Melt Toastie
description: Pan-toasted sandwich with tuna, corn and melted cheese
instructions: Mix the drained tuna with the corn and pepper
Butter one side of each slice of bread and put one slice butter side down in a pan
Top with the tuna and grated cheese and the second slice, butter side up
Toast over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese has melted

name: Stuffed Sweet Potato with Chickpeas
description: Baked sweet potato filled with spiced chickpeas and spinach
instructions: Prick the sweet potato all over and microwave on high for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until soft
Warm the drained chickpeas in the olive oil with the paprika, cumin and salt for 3 minutes
Stir in the spinach until it wilts
Split the sweet potato, fill it with the chickpeas and finish with lemon juice

name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
description: Clear soup with chicken, potato, carrot and peas
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil in a pot for 3 minutes
Add the diced potatoes and carrots, the water, stock cube and the whole piece of chicken and simmer for 18 minutes
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot with the peas
Cook 2 more minutes and season with pepper and parsley

name: Ham, Cheese and Spinach Omelette
description: Three-egg omelette with ham, cheese and spinach, with toast
instructions: Beat the eggs with pepper, cut the ham into strips and grate the cheese
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan, wilt the spinach for 30 seconds and pour in the eggs
When almost set, scatter the ham and cheese over one half and fold over
Cook 1 more minute and serve with the toasted bread

name: Warm Salmon and Potato Salad
description: Flaked salmon with potatoes and green beans in a lemon yogurt dressing
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 5, then drain
Fry the salmon in the olive oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side and break into flakes
Mix the yogurt with the mustard, the juice of the lemon, salt and pepper
Toss the warm potatoes and beans in the dressing and fold in the salmon

name: Turkey, Bacon and Avocado Sandwich
description: Toasted sandwich with turkey, crisp bacon, avocado and tomato
instructions: Fry the bacon in a dry pan over medium heat for 4 minutes until crisp and set it aside
Slice the turkey thinly, season and fry it in the bacon fat for 4 minutes until cooked through
Toast the bread and spread it with the mashed avocado
Layer on the turkey, bacon, sliced tomato and lettuce

name: Chicken Quinoa Bowl
description: Quinoa with chicken, broccoli and carrot in a lemon olive oil dressing
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in salted water for 12 to 15 minutes, adding the broccoli florets for the last 3, then drain
Season the chicken and fry it in half the olive oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice
Grate the carrots
Serve the quinoa and broccoli topped with the chicken and carrots, dressed with the remaining olive oil and the juice of the lemon

name: Beef and Potato Hash
description: Skillet of beef mince, crisp potatoes, onion and peas
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1 cm cubes and fry them in the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning, until golden and tender
Push them aside, add the beef mince and diced onion and brown for 6 minutes
Stir in the peas, paprika, salt and pepper and cook 2 more minutes

name: Pork Schnitzel Sandwich
description: Thin breaded pork cutlet in bread with lettuce
instructions: Flatten the pork between two sheets of baking paper until about 1 cm thick and season it
Coat it in the flour, then in the beaten egg, then in the flour again
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through
Spread the bread with mustard, add the lettuce and schnitzel and squeeze over lemon juice

name: Tofu Scramble Wrap
description: Tortilla filled with scrambled tofu, spinach, peppers and tomato
instructions: Dice the peppers and cook them in the oil for 3 minutes
Crumble in the tofu with the turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper and cook for 5 minutes
Stir in the spinach and diced tomato until the spinach wilts
Warm the tortilla, add the scramble and roll up

name: Crispy Fish Sandwich
description: Pan-fried breaded white fish in bread with lettuce and lemon yogurt
instructions: Cut the fish into thick strips, season and coat in the flour, then the beaten egg, then the flour again
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden
Stir lemon juice into the yogurt
Fill the bread with the lettuce, fish and yogurt sauce

name: Shrimp and Avocado Salad
description: Quick salad of pan-fried shrimp, avocado, tomato and cucumber with lemon
instructions: Fry the shrimp in half the olive oil over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until pink and season
Dice the avocado, tomato and cucumber and tear the lettuce
Toss the salad with the remaining olive oil and the juice of the lemon and top with the shrimp

name: Chicken Burger
description: Juicy chicken mince patty in bread with cheese, lettuce and tomato
instructions: Mix the chicken mince with the paprika, salt and pepper and shape into a flat patty
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes per side until cooked through, laying the cheese on top for the last minute
Toast the bread and spread with mustard
Add the lettuce, patty and sliced tomato

name: Turkey and Vegetable Rice Skillet
description: One-pan turkey mince with rice, zucchini and peppers in tomato sauce
instructions: Brown the turkey mince in the oil in a lidded pan for 5 minutes
Add the diced zucchini and peppers and the paprika and cook for 3 minutes
Stir in the rice, tomato sauce, water and salt, cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until the rice is tender
Season with pepper

name: Meatball Sandwich
description: Meatballs in tomato sauce with melted cheese in bread
instructions: Season the mixed mince with the oregano, salt and pepper and roll it into {5} small balls
Fry them in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes, turning, until browned
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through
Spoon onto the bread, top with the grated cheese and close the sandwich

name: Egg, Potato and Green Bean Salad
description: Warm salad of potatoes, green beans, tomato and boiled eggs
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, for 15 minutes, adding the eggs for the last 8 minutes and the green beans for the last 5
Drain, cool the eggs under cold water, peel and quarter them
Whisk the olive oil with the mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper
Toss the potatoes, beans and tomato wedges in the dressing and top with the eggs

name: Chicken, Bacon and Corn Chowder
description: Creamy soup with chicken, bacon, potato and corn
instructions: Fry the chopped bacon with the butter in a pot for 3 minutes, then add the diced onion for 3 minutes
Add the diced potatoes, the chicken in small pieces, the water and stock cube and simmer for 15 minutes
Stir in the corn and milk and heat gently for 3 minutes without boiling
Lightly crush some of the potatoes to thicken and season with pepper

name: Chicken and Avocado Rice Bowl
description: Rice bowl with sliced chicken, avocado, corn and tomato
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Season the chicken and fry it in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice
Dice the avocado and tomato
Top the rice with the chicken, avocado, corn and tomato and squeeze over lime juice

name: Beef Burger with Potato Wedges
description: Cheeseburger with lettuce and tomato and oven wedges
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C, cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil, paprika and salt and roast for 25 minutes, turning once
Season the beef mince, shape it into a patty and fry in a dry pan over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side
Lay the cheese on the patty for the last minute so it melts
Serve in the bread with the lettuce and sliced tomato, with the wedges on the side

name: Steak and Onion Sandwich
description: Seared beef with soft onions and cheese in toasted bread
instructions: Slice the onion and cook it in the butter over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft and golden, then push aside
Season the beef and sear it in the same pan over high heat for 2 minutes per side, rest for 2 minutes and slice thinly
Toast the bread and spread with mustard
Fill with the lettuce, beef, onions and sliced cheese

name: Pork and Apple Salad
description: Pan-fried pork strips over lettuce with apple, cucumber and a mustard dressing
instructions: Cut the pork into thin strips, season and fry in half the olive oil over high heat for 4 to 5 minutes
Slice the apple and cucumber thinly and tear the lettuce
Whisk the remaining olive oil with the mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper
Toss the salad in the dressing, top with the pork and serve with the bread

name: Chicken Pesto Panini
description: Pressed sandwich with chicken, mozzarella, tomato and pesto
instructions: Season the chicken and fry it in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice
Spread the pesto on the bread and layer on the chicken, sliced mozzarella and sliced tomato to make a double-decker sandwich
Toast it in the dry pan over medium heat, pressing down with a spatula, for 2 to 3 minutes per side until the cheese melts

name: Beef and Bean Lunch Burritos
description: Two burritos with spiced beef mince, kidney beans and cheese
instructions: Brown the beef mince in a dry pan over high heat for 6 minutes
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, drained kidney beans and a splash of water and cook for 2 minutes
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Fill them with the beef and beans, grated cheese and diced tomato, fold in the sides and roll up

name: Salmon and Avocado Rice Bowl
description: Pan-fried salmon over rice with avocado, cucumber and soy
seasonings: sesame seeds if you have them
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Fry the salmon in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side and break into large flakes
Slice the avocado and cucumber
Top the rice with the salmon, avocado and cucumber and dress with the soy sauce and lime juice

name: Peanut Chicken Noodles
description: Warm noodles with chicken and carrot in a peanut soy sauce
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet and drain
Slice the chicken and stir-fry it in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes with the carrots cut into thin strips
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, hot water and lime juice
Toss the noodles and sauce through the chicken and heat for 1 minute

name: Tuna Pesto Pasta
description: Pasta with tuna, peas and pesto
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain
Toss with the pesto and the drained tuna
Season with pepper and lemon juice

name: Beef and Egg Fried Rice
description: Fried rice with beef strips, scrambled egg and peas
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it steam dry
Slice the beef thinly and sear it in the oil over very high heat for 2 minutes with the ginger
Push it aside, scramble the eggs in the gap, then add the peas
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes

name: Chicken, Feta and Chickpea Couscous
description: Couscous with oregano chicken, chickpeas, cucumber and feta
instructions: Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork
Season the chicken with the oregano and salt and fry in half the olive oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice
Mix the couscous with the drained chickpeas, diced cucumber, remaining olive oil and lemon juice
Top with the chicken and crumbled feta

name: Tofu Peanut Rice Bowl
description: Golden tofu over rice with carrot, cucumber and a peanut soy sauce
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, hot water and lime juice
Serve the tofu over the rice with the grated carrots and sliced cucumber and pour over the sauce

name: Lentil and Chickpea Power Bowl
description: Warm lentils and chickpeas with avocado and tomato
instructions: Simmer the rinsed lentils in unsalted water for 20 to 25 minutes until tender, adding the drained chickpeas for the last 2 minutes, then drain
Toss with the olive oil, vinegar, cumin, salt and pepper
Dice the tomato and avocado and fold them through

name: Turkey and Cheese Quesadilla
description: Crisp tortillas with turkey, peppers and melted cheese
instructions: Slice the turkey thinly, season with the paprika, cumin and salt and fry in the oil with the diced peppers for 6 minutes
Cover one tortilla with half the grated cheese, the turkey and peppers and the rest of the cheese, and top with the second tortilla
Cook in a clean dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden
Cut into wedges

name: Bacon, Egg and Potato Hash
description: Crisp potatoes with bacon and onion, topped with three fried eggs
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1 cm cubes and fry them in the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes until golden
Add the chopped bacon and diced onion with the paprika and cook for 5 minutes until the bacon is crisp
Make {n:eggs} gaps in the hash, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 3 minutes until the whites are set
Season with pepper

name: Creamy Garlic Shrimp Pasta
description: Pasta with shrimp and spinach in a garlic parmesan cream sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain, keeping a little of the water
Fry the shrimp in a non-stick pan over high heat for 2 minutes with the sliced garlic
Add the cream sauce, spinach and a splash of pasta water and simmer for 2 minutes
Toss in the pasta and grated parmesan and finish with pepper and lemon juice

name: Chicken Meatball Sub
description: Chicken meatballs in tomato sauce with melted mozzarella in bread
instructions: Season the chicken mince with the oregano, salt and pepper and roll it into {6} balls
Brown them in a non-stick pan for 6 minutes, turning
Add the tomato sauce, cover and simmer for 6 minutes until cooked through
Pile the meatballs and sauce onto the bread, top with the sliced mozzarella and let it melt for a minute before closing the sandwich

name: Warm Tofu and Lentil Salad
description: Golden tofu over lentils with tomato, cucumber and a lemon dressing
instructions: Rinse the lentils and simmer them in {300} ml of salted water for 18 to 20 minutes until tender, then drain
Pat the tofu dry, cut it into cubes and fry it in half of the olive oil over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until golden
Dice the tomato and the cucumber and toss them with the lentils, the rest of the olive oil, the lemon juice, oregano, salt and black pepper
Top the salad with the warm tofu

name: Chickpea and Tofu Spinach Bowl
description: Chickpeas and crumbled tofu fried with spinach, tomato and smoked paprika
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, crumble the tofu and dice the tomato
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu and the chickpeas with the smoked paprika, cumin and salt for 6 minutes until they start to colour
Add the tomato and the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until the spinach has wilted
Season with black pepper and serve in a bowl

name: Teriyaki Tofu Rice Bowl
description: Seared tofu glazed with teriyaki over rice with peas and carrot
instructions: Cook the rice in {100} ml of salted water, covered, for 12 minutes, then leave it to steam off the heat
Pat the tofu dry and cut it into cubes; slice the carrots thinly
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 6 minutes until golden, then add the carrots and the peas and cook for 3 minutes
Pour in the teriyaki, toss for 1 minute until glossy, and serve over the rice

name: Bean and Tofu Burrito Bowl
description: Kidney beans and spiced tofu with corn, peppers and fresh tomato, no rice
seasonings: squeeze of lime or lemon juice
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans and the corn; dice the peppers and the tomato and crumble the tofu into chunks
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu with the cumin, smoked paprika and salt for 5 minutes
Add the peppers, the beans and the corn and cook for 4 minutes until hot
Serve in a bowl with the tomato on top and a squeeze of lime or lemon juice

name: Lentil and Tofu Vegetable Soup
description: A thick tomato and lentil soup with carrot, spinach and cubes of tofu
instructions: Dice the onion and the carrots and soften them in the olive oil in a pot over medium heat for 4 minutes
Add the rinsed lentils, the chopped tomatoes, the cumin and {450} ml of water, bring to the boil and simmer for 18 minutes
Cut the tofu into small cubes and add it with the spinach; simmer for 3 more minutes
Season with salt and black pepper and serve

name: Tofu and Pea Quinoa Stir-Fry
description: Quinoa stir-fried with golden tofu, peas, peppers and soy sauce
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in {100} ml of water, covered, for 12 minutes, then fluff it with a fork
Pat the tofu dry and cut it into cubes; dice the peppers
Heat the oil in a pan over high heat and fry the tofu for 6 minutes until golden, then add the peppers and the peas and cook for 2 minutes
Add the quinoa and the soy sauce, toss for 1 minute and serve
